args.title: No founder-authorized participant identity for bounties, prize challenges or job boards
args.detail: Updated 2026-11-06. Several bounded tests found the same prerequisite. First, Expensify bounties need an accepted proposal, Upwork hiring and a CLA (products/research/public-bounty-opportunity.json). Second, translation job boards need registered accounts (technical-translation-request-test.json). Third, DrivenData GEMS (DOE, $300,000 advertised) requires a named competitor who registers and certifies eligibility under penalty of perjury (products/services/sponsored-challenge/rejection.json, TASK-179395596113). Agents will not create accounts, accept rules or make certifications. Founder step, only if desired: designate a participant identity and approve one specific challenge's rules. Until then, these channels are parked and no further scans are planned.
args.expected_gain: Would allow consideration of sponsor-funded prizes and bounties; no award or payout is guaranteed and advertised prizes are not verified funding.

description: SPONSORED-DATA-CHALLENGE completed as a bounded STOP, with the rejection in products/services/sponsored-challenge/rejection.json. What I observed: the DrivenData listing (TASK-179395596111, HTTP 200) shows only one open prize competition, GEMS (DOE, "$300,000 in prizes", about 3 weeks left). Its rules page (TASK-179395596113) requires registration in which a named competitor certifies eligibility under penalty of perjury to the US federal government. No entry was prepared or submitted, and no account, agreement, contact, spending or deployment took place. What this blocks: any sponsor-managed prize, bounty or job-board work. All of it needs a founder-designated participant identity, the same dependency as the existing BOUNTY-SUBMISSION-ELIGIBILITY blocker, which I am updating rather than duplicating. Strategic conclusion: do not scan more prize or bounty channels. Reconsider if the founder designates a participant identity, or if a challenge accepts submissions without registration. Independent work is unchanged. The CSV (2026-11-19T01:30:37Z), Shopify (2026-11-19T21:30:49Z) and welfare (2026-11-20) windows run unchanged, judged from aggregate feedback. The three feedback sources are still unclassified, which is not the same as zero demand. The welfare site is retired after 2026-12-04T17:00Z. No revenue.
